verdict: One base for all three (100 = Jan 2021, first reliable month). Oct 1, 2026 mark: BS1E 184.11, BSSL 129.40, BS99 110.43. Jan 2021 -> Aug 2026 (monthly reconstruction): +70.7% / +30.2% / +13.7%. Aug 2025 -> Aug 2026: +38.8% / +61.1% / +30.3% (Shadowless led). Worst drawdown: -34.1% / -43.8% / -42.0%. Charizard ungraded sold medians (read Oct 4): 1st Ed $10,253.00 (4 sales, Jul 18–Aug 31, 90d), Shadowless $988.00 (5, Sep 5–17, 30d), Unlimited $350.00 (29, Sep 27–Oct 4, 30d). PSA 9: 1st Ed no sale in 90d (last Jun 30, 2026 $69,900.00), Shadowless $11,592.10 (6, Jul 8–Sep 22, 90d), Unlimited $3,500.00 (10, Sep 5–29, 30d). PSA 10: 1st Ed no sale in 90d (last Jun 23, 2026 $343,098.00), Shadowless no sold read, Unlimited $9,150.00 (2, Aug 14–16, 90d). Blastoise $1,537.50 / $250.00 / $92.00; Venusaur $1,025.00 / $199.99 / $67.50 (counts and windows on page). Charizard lowest raw English asks Oct 4: $11,500 / $700 / $219.95 (listed damaged), labelled asks.
